resonance.super_pallet_towner.scope: Condition: both trainer and Pokémon effects work only while a conscious party Pokémon has this type.
Interpretation: fire and burning damage are cancelled directly instead of a Fire Resistance status (no icon). Lava is only reduced.
Pokémon environment reduction covers fire damage with no attacker (fire, lava, burning), outside battles.
resonance.super_pallet_towner.note.water: Water Breathing is applied without a status icon.
Pokémon recovery is added on top of Cobblemon's timed party healing.
resonance.super_pallet_towner.note.grass: Regeneration is added to vanilla natural regeneration (high food); none when naturalRegeneration is off.
Hunger: exhaustion builds up more slowly; food changes by commands or other mods are kept.
resonance.super_pallet_towner.note.elect: Interpretation: the Pokémon "action/attack speed equivalent vs mobs" is implemented as more damage vs mobs.
resonance.super_pallet_towner.note.ice.1: You still sink into powder snow.
resonance.super_pallet_towner.note.ice.2: Interpretation: the Pokémon "ice/snow environment immunity" is implemented as freeze-damage immunity (outside battles).
resonance.super_pallet_towner.note.fight: Knockback applies to targets hit by the trainer (melee and projectiles).
Interpretation: Pokémon "physical" means melee moves only; special, ranged and area moves do not count (Fight or Flight).
resonance.super_pallet_towner.note.poiso: Interpretation: the Pokémon "poison/status resistance" is a shorter harmful effect duration (outside battles); does not stack with Fairy.
resonance.super_pallet_towner.note.flyin: Flight works like creative flight (double jump) and ends with the resonance.
Interpretation: the Pokémon "movement support" is more movement speed while sent out, outside battles.
resonance.super_pallet_towner.note.psych: Cooldowns: NeoOrigins powers only (Puffish Skills has none). The display may show the unshortened time.
Pokémon EXP: nothing is added when the EXP is 0, e.g. at a level cap.
resonance.super_pallet_towner.note.bug.1: Jump height grows by about twice the jump-strength percentage.
resonance.super_pallet_towner.note.bug.2: Interpretation: the Pokémon "evasion/durability equivalent vs mobs" is implemented as less damage from mobs.
Ores are blocks in the c:ores tag. Adds to Normal's mining bonus.
resonance.super_pallet_towner.note.ghost: Mobs use a shorter follow range for you and do not start targeting you beyond it; a mob already targeting you keeps doing so.
resonance.super_pallet_towner.note.drago: The damage reduction applies to all damage and multiplies with fall reductions.
Night Vision has no status icon. Night follows the world time.
resonance.super_pallet_towner.note.steel: Armor wear is reduced on each hit; held tools, weapons and shields get part of the wear back (same rate over time).
resonance.super_pallet_towner.note.fairy: Applies to newly added harmful effects (not infinite ones).

resonance.super_pallet_towner.link.rock_: Harvest tier +1: wood → stone → iron → diamond → netherite (vanilla gold harvests like wood, so it acts as stone)
Mining speed of the next tier: wood %s → stone %s → iron %s → diamond %s → netherite %s (Efficiency still adds)
Faster tools never slow down (gold %s keeps its speed; gold that Quark already lets mine iron gains nothing)
Netherite and other top-tier tools do not change
Rock's mining +%s%% and ore +%s%% multiply on top
The item itself is unchanged (material, durability, damage and enchantments)
Applies to tools using the vanilla tier tags (vanilla tools and mod tools built like them); mod tools with their own tiers are not affected
resonance.super_pallet_towner.link.condi: Condition: the linked types match this combination exactly and all are active (a conscious party Pokémon has each)

Equipment durability use: an additional -%s%% (total cap applies)

Knockback resistance: up to +%s%% more (total cap applies)

Total lava damage -75%; immune to hot-floor damage. Matching Pokémon: -75% environmental fire/lava damage, +6% damage vs Mobs.

resonance.super_pallet_towner.link.air_e: Movement speed targets +15% total; immune to lightning. Matching Pokémon: +10% movement and +8% Mob attack-rate equivalent.
resonance.super_pallet_towner.link.elect: Attract drops within four blocks. Matching Pokémon: +20% knockback resistance and -5% damage taken vs Mobs.

resonance.super_pallet_towner.link.dark_: Suppress player-caused vibrations (including sculk sensors); total Mob detection range -40%. Matching Pokémon at night: +8% damage and -10% damage taken vs Mobs.
resonance.super_pallet_towner.link.ice_w: Turn exposed water sources into temporary ice in daylight; normal-ground traction on ice. Matching Pokémon: +10% world movement and -6% damage taken vs Mobs.
resonance.super_pallet_towner.link.drago: +10% player melee damage vs Minecraft Mobs, or +15% against Mobs above 50 maximum HP. Matching Pokémon: +10% physical melee damage vs Mobs and +15% knockback resistance.
resonance.super_pallet_towner.link.psych: Total harmful-effect duration -40%; total Origin cooldown -15%. Matching Pokémon: +12% natural recovery and -6% damage taken vs Mobs.
resonance.super_pallet_towner.link.bug_g: Each harvested mature crop item has a 25% extra-drop chance; total jump strength +20%. Matching Pokémon: +10% natural recovery and +8% world movement.
resonance.super_pallet_towner.link.norma: Total attack speed targets +10%; total mining speed +10%. Matching Pokémon: +6% damage vs Mobs and +10% knockback resistance.
resonance.super_pallet_towner.link.fire_: Harvest tier +1, extra mining speed +15%, smelt ore raw materials, total durability use -30%, total lava damage -75%. Matching Pokémon: +8% damage and -8% damage taken vs Mobs.
resonance.super_pallet_towner.link.air_e: Free-flight speed +30%; movement targets +15% total; immune to lightning and falls. Matching Pokémon: +15% world movement and +10% Mob attack-rate equivalent.
resonance.super_pallet_towner.link.fairy: Total natural recovery +30%, received healing +20%, hunger consumption -20%, no submerged mining penalty. Matching Pokémon: +20% natural recovery and -30% harmful-effect duration.
resonance.super_pallet_towner.link.dark_: Night vision; total Mob detection range -50%; suppress player-caused vibrations; no fall damage; total Origin cooldown -20%. Matching Pokémon: +10% damage vs Mobs at night, -10% damage taken vs Mobs at all times.
resonance.super_pallet_towner.link.elect: Total attack speed +15%, armor toughness +3, knockback resistance +35%, attract drops within four blocks. Matching Pokémon: +8% damage, -6% damage taken vs Mobs, +25% knockback resistance.
resonance.super_pallet_towner.link.ice_r: Total armor +4, toughness +2, total knockback resistance +40%, no powder-snow freezing and normal-ground traction on ice. Matching Pokémon: -12% damage taken vs Mobs and +30% knockback resistance.
resonance.super_pallet_towner.link.drago: Total maximum HP +4, immune to fire, free-flight speed +20%, +15% melee damage vs large Minecraft Mobs. Matching Pokémon: +10% damage vs Mobs and immune to environmental fire.
resonance.super_pallet_towner.link.fairy: Total received healing +30%, immune to Darkness and Blindness, total Origin cooldown -15%, ignite nearby undead Mobs. Matching Pokémon: +10% damage vs undead Mobs and +15% natural recovery.
resonance.super_pallet_towner.link.rock_: Extra mining speed +10%. Matching Pokémon: -8% damage taken vs Mobs and +15% knockback resistance (global caps apply).
